sphere.latitude_registration: phi(y,A) = 90 - 180y/1200 + A sin(pi y/1200); A=+18,0,-18 degrees. Inverse by monotone bisection.
sphere.area_integration: Spherical area per pixel fraction = (sin(phi_top) - sin(phi_bottom)) / (2*240); sums to 1 over all world cells. Based on raster occupancy, not high-resolution polygon area.

projections.title: 摩尔威德等面积
projections.forward: theta solves 2theta+sin(2theta)=pi sin(phi); x=2sqrt2*(lon rad)/pi*cos(theta); y=sqrt2 sin(theta)

sphere.seam: B26 owner grid handles the western negative-x seam by ±2400 source polygon copies; B27 projection display samples this same wrapped owner grid.
sphere.sample_caveat: Area figures are candidate spherical-mapping pixel-mask measurements, NOT actual Orbina continents or real planet land fraction.

H4_orographic_screen.method: Given a hypothetical cardinal incoming wind, compute z(current)-z(upwind neighbor) in B20 H4 synthetic 0–100 height grid. Positive values are one-cell ascending-slope proxy; negative are descending-slope proxy.
H4_orographic_screen.threshold: >=5 index points, not measured degrees or percent slope
H4_orographic_screen.note: The H4 experimental grid has no approved alignment with B16 global coordinates, and wind names denote ONLY local drawing directions. An uphill slope is not calibrated rain; a downhill slope is not by itself regional rain shadow.

scientific_boundaries: Projection choice changes a picture's shapes/area distortion, not its accepted geography.
B26 ±18 degree latitude-registration options are not actual tectonic drifts or official planet coordinates.
Mollweide and Lambert equal-area properties apply to sphere only; physical ellipsoid is unknown.
No official country/ocean coastline, spin, axial tilt, planetary radius, annual rainfall or river source is set.
The candidate map may be visibly over-spread around polar latitudes; testing it does not approve it.
H4 synthetic slopes cannot be placed on B16 global candidate continents without explicit terrain registration.
